CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_flow_metrics (
    recordregistry CHARACTER(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    last_updated TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    dte NUMERIC,
    success_pct NUMERIC,
    error_tally SMALLINT
);

    recordregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(successpct AS NUMERIC) / CAST((errtally + 1.0) AS NUMERIC), 4),
    successpct,
    errtally
FROM dataflow
ON CONFLICT (recordregistry) DO UPDATE SET
    dte = EXCLUDED.dte,
    success_pct = EXCLUDED.success_pct,
    error_tally = EXCLUDED.error_tally,
    last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
